[Energy Heart](/Feats.aspx?ID=9223) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Evolution" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=959" />
<trait label="Summoner" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=954" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 78

</column>

---

Your eidolon’s heart beats with energy. Choose [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524), [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586), or [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604). One of their unarmed attacks changes its damage type to the chosen type, and they gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) to that type equal to half your level (minimum 1).

<title level="2">Energy Heart leads to...</title>
[Dual Energy Heart](/Feats.aspx?ID=9237), [Energy Resistance](/Feats.aspx?ID=9253)
